videos.name: Volcano
videos.frame0: Atlas (half-closed eyes) fills lower ~45 %; dusk volcano + lava river; cut-out biplane enters 0.5 s, bomb 1.0 s, blast 2.0 s; caption THE US ARMY…
videos.biggest_drop: 5.4–10 s: end of meta line «…way we fought lava.» + 0.71 s pause + «1935, Hawaii.» over 3-photo collage → «Iceland 1973» card → globe from space «1935» → satellite map «Mauna Loa / HAWAII»; awr 1.008→0.665
videos.outro: scoreboard «Final score: Humans 2 Volcano 0 … And Hawaii? We don’t talk about Hawaii.» 68.4–76.8 s, motion 0.29–0.91 in 70–75 s; awr 0.444→0.267

videos.name: Rabbits
videos.frame0: 3D toon ship, 13 small brown rabbits walking down the gangplank (living beings, mid-distance), Atlas lower-left with pointer; date label «England October 1859» from 0.5 s
videos.biggest_drop: 5–19.5 s: «Turns out, rabbits can multiply» (classroom gag) → «Twenty-four became hundreds of millions» over flat Australia map + «≈600 million by 1950 estimate (CSIRO)» → «Round one: a prize» £25,000 / NSW 1887 card → Pasteur photo + «He sent his team to Sydney» → «Rodd Island lab Sydney»; awr 1.05→0.418
videos.outro: scoreboard «Three rounds: rabbits two, flies one, Australia zero … Probably.» 51.7–62 s, motion 0.11–1.17 in 52–57 s; awr 0.296→0.153

videos.name: Yellow Fleet (B+friend)
videos.frame0: still 3D toon canal, ships in a row, NO living being, big static «1-DAY TRIP» card; nothing moves for ~5 s (motion 0.56–0.87 in s 0–4); strike-out ≈3.3 s, «8 YEARS» ≈4 s
videos.biggest_drop: 0–2 s (−0.197, partly loopers leaving on 2nd pass) and 4.6–7.6 s (1.148→0.970): «…eight years later. Halfway through, war broke out. Egypt sank» — whole premise already told at 4.97 s; flat 2D ship diagram 7.5–9.5 s
videos.outro: CTA «How many stars for this delivery?» 29.4–31.3 s; awr 0.673→0.465; last frame = frame 0 (seamless loop)
